title: Linear inner product PCPP description
statement: For each positive natural number $m$, the described Boolean property tester uses proofs of length $2m+1$, makes three queries, and has rejection rate $1/4$. It tests the property that the inner product over the field with two elements of the two length-$m$ blocks of the input equals $1$.
